decisions.label: Dodge and take-off share one cooldown
decisions.note: On, her dodge and her take-off share one counter (Ed, 2026-10-15: "One trail, one cooldown"): a dodge adds the dodge cooldown, a take-off the take-off amount, a landing the flying cooldown (#916), each going only when the counter has room for it; her trail is as long as the counter is full. Off: the dodge's charges and the flying cooldown run apart as before.

decisions.label: Take-off adds (s)
decisions.note: Seconds a take-off adds to the shared counter (2 now; the plain broom halves it). Over the counter's room, a take-off needs it empty.

decisions.label: Dodge adds (s)
decisions.note: Seconds a dodge adds to the shared counter (1 as shipped; shared off, the seconds before the next blink comes back).

decisions.label: Dodges in a row
decisions.note: How many dodges the counter has room for (2 as shipped, Ed 2026-10-08: its room is this times the dodge's seconds; shared off, her blinks before the cooldown). The flying cooldown (#916) adds more than the room, so after landing both wait.

decisions.label: Trail per full cooldown (m)
decisions.note: Her trail is at least this many metres times the counter's share in use (full right after a take-off or a landing, half after a dodge with two in hand), draining with it. 0: the trail shows only her speed, as before.

decisions.label: Trail by speed too
decisions.note: On, her speed still gives the trail its length as before (5 m at full speed on the ground, 20 m over the treetops), the cooldown's length over it. Off, the trail shows the cooldown alone.
